items.prompt: Why can own average fill price differ from market VWAP?

options.text: Both always weight exactly the same quantities
options.why: Own fills and market trades are different observations.

options.text: Market VWAP contains no volume weights
options.why: Its defining weights are eligible trade volumes.

options.text: They weight different trades/quantities within stated scope
options.why: A partial schedule need not replicate the market profile.

options.text: A difference always proves an accounting error

items.explanation: Compare matched windows and labels, and report filled exposure rather than assuming benchmark replication.
